जुगुप्सनम्, जुगुप्सा
—1 Censure, reproach.
—2 Dislike, aversion, disgust, abhorrence.
—3 (In Rhet.) Disgust considered as the feeling which gives rise to the
 Bībhatsa sentiment, thus defined:− दोषेक्षणादिभिर्गर्हा जुगुप्सा विषयोद्भवा S. D. 207.

जुगुप्सनम्, जुगुप्सा
—1 Censure, reproach.
—2 Dislike, aversion, disgust, abhorrence.
—3 (In Rhet.) Disgust considered as the feeling which gives rise to the
 Bībhatsa sentiment, thus defined:− दोषेक्षणादिभिर्गर्हा जुगुप्सा विषयोद्भवा S. D. 207.

जुगुप्सितम् A disgusting or horrible deed; जुगुप्सितं धर्मकृतेऽनुशासतः
 Bhāg. 1. 5. 15. कर्मजुगुप्सितेन ibid. 1. 7. 42.
